Mathematician and writer Eric Weinstein returns to the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 2503, a late entry in one of the show's longest guest runs. Weinstein is known for bold claims about physics, universities, and public debate. Rogan mostly sets a topic loose and lets him run.

The talk ranges across science politics, media habits, and Weinstein's long fight to get his own physics ideas a fair hearing. He criticizes the gatekeepers he blames for stale thinking, and Rogan tests the claims as a fan and a skeptic at once. Fans of Weinstein's past visits will find his core themes pressed further here.
